facts.text: Dodge City, known as the “Queen of the Cowtowns,” was born on the Santa Fe Trail and shaped by buffalo hunters and trail‑driving cowboys.
The historic Front Street exhibit at the Dodge City History Museum reconstructs downtown as it appeared in 1876, including the Long Branch Saloon and Saratoga Saloon.
Dodge City’s Boot Hill Cemetery, preserved in the museum, is the original burial ground for many of the town’s early cowboys and lawmen.
In 2026, True West Magazine named Dodge City a Top Western Town, reaffirming its status as a living reminder of the Old West.
